articles.summary: OECD PISA data collected in 2025, the first study since AI use went mainstream, found students who use AI to study tend to score worse, though certain uses give a slight boost, especially among students taught to critically assess AI tool performance.

articles.title: Beyond Right and Wrong: Evaluating Second-order Social Reasoning in Large Language Models
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.05437v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Previous AI alignment efforts have focused primarily on first-order social norms -- teaching models what is socially acceptable or unacceptable (e.g., `do not steal'). However, social intelligence depends not only on norm recognition, but also on anticipating who will enforce it and how (e.g., public shame or even imprisonment). articles.summary: This paper introduces a framework for evaluating metanorm reasoning in LLMs—second-order social expectations about how people respond when rules are broken. It aims to move beyond first-order norms like 'do not steal' to capture deeper social intelligence.
articles.summaryZhHK: 呢篇論文提出一個評估 LLM 中 metanorm 推理嘅框架——即係關於規則被打破時人哋點樣回應嘅二階社會期望。佢旨在超越好似「唔好偷嘢」呢啲一階規範，去捕捉更深層嘅社會智能。

articles.title: CriticGen: Generation-Aware Evaluation as Actionable Feedback
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.05439v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Current evaluation methods for large language models are coarse-grained and decoupled from generation, producing generic explanations that fail to provide actionable feedback for model improvement. We propose CriticGen, a fine-grained, generation-aware evaluation framework that turns evaluation into actionable control for answer improvement. CriticGen first generates sample-specific evaluation dimensions and scoring criteria under high-level categories such as subjective, objective, and self-derived constraints. articles.summary: CriticGen is a fine-grained, generation-aware evaluation framework that turns evaluation into actionable control for answer improvement. It generates sample-specific evaluation dimensions and scoring criteria to provide actionable feedback for model improvement.
articles.summaryZhHK: CriticGen 係一個細粒度、generation-aware 嘅評估框架，將評估轉化為對答案改進嘅可行控制。佢生成樣本特定嘅評估維度同評分標準，為模型改進提供可行嘅反饋。

articles.title: When Does Memory Help? A Cost-Aware Evaluation of Long-Term Memory in Tool-Using LLM Agents
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.05441v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-term memory for LLM agents is evaluated today by conversational recall benchmarks (LoCoMo, LongMemEval), which measure question answering over dialogue history, not whether remembered facts change what a tool-using agent does. We present MERIT (Memory Evaluation for Realistic Instrumented Tasks), a benchmark and harness that measures the marginal utility of memory for task-executing agents under explicit cost accounting. articles.summary: This paper presents MERIT, a benchmark and harness that measures the marginal utility of long-term memory for tool-using LLM agents under explicit cost accounting. It provides episodic tool-use tasks across three domains to evaluate whether remembered facts change agent behavior.
articles.summaryZhHK: 呢篇論文介紹 MERIT，一個 benchmark 同 harness，用嚟喺明確成本核算下衡量長期記憶對使用工具嘅 LLM agent 嘅邊際效用。佢提供三個領域嘅 episodic tool-use 任務，評估記住嘅事實會唔會改變 agent 行為。

articles.title: AutoFyn Technical Report: Non-Parametric Expert Iteration for Long-Horizon Agents
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.05446v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce AutoFyn, an agent harness inspired by the Expert Iteration algorithm, adapting a frozen model across many rounds by updating persistent state from verified reward signals rather than model weights. Each round begins from a fresh model session, and durable information is reintroduced only through explicit interfaces such as persistent memory files, reports, and repository state. articles.summary: AutoFyn is an agent harness inspired by Expert Iteration that adapts a frozen model by updating persistent state from verified reward signals rather than model weights. It uses an orchestrator to explore and plan multiple approaches with specialized agents in each round.
articles.summaryZhHK: AutoFyn 係一個受 Expert Iteration 啟發嘅 agent harness，通過更新來自已驗證獎勵信號嘅持久狀態嚟適應 frozen model，而唔係模型權重。佢每輪用 orchestrator 同專門 agent 探索同規劃多種方法。

articles.title: Damage-Aware Bandit Pruning for Vision and Language Transformers
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.05448v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Structured post-training pruning of transformers requires selecting complete functional units whose suppression causes limited degradation. articles.summary: This paper formulates structured-unit pruning for language and vision transformers as a damage-aware multi-armed bandit problem under a fixed evaluation budget. articles.summaryZhHK: 呢篇論文將語言同視覺 transformer 嘅結構化單元剪枝，表述為固定評估預算下一個 damage-aware 多臂老虎機問題。佢喺校準批次上遮罩 attention heads 同 MLP channel groups，用 paired damage 指標嚟減少批次差異。

articles.title: Compiling VGDL into Causal Models
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.05459v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reinforcement learning and large language models often struggle to accurately capture the causal mechanics of game environments. Standard reinforcement learning agents tend to rely on spurious correlations, while large language models are prone to hallucinating game rules. Although causal reinforcement learning improves interpretability, there is currently no formal methodology to map complex game mechanics directly into causal models. articles.summary: This paper proposes a deterministic framework that compiles games specified in the Video Game Description Language (VGDL) into causal models. It aims to improve RL and LLM agents' ability to capture the causal mechanics of game environments.
articles.summaryZhHK: 呢篇論文提出一個確定性框架，將用 Video Game Description Language (VGDL) 指定嘅遊戲編譯成因果模型。佢旨在改善 RL 同 LLM agent 捕捉遊戲環境因果機制嘅能力。

articles.title: SciLitBench: Benchmark and Design Principles for LLM-Powered Systematic Literature Reviews
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.05505v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Systematic reviews require sustained human judgment across thousands of records, yet existing evaluations of large language models (LLMs) typically examine review stages in isolation. articles.summary: SciLitBench is a multi-stage benchmark for LLM-powered systematic literature reviews, covering screening and data extraction stages with over 42,000 retrieved records. articles.title: SCAFFOLD: Self-Improving Web Agents via Recursive Parametric Skill Abstraction
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.05511v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Web agents need to navigate visually rich, long-horizon interfaces that change across sites, yet most previous agents still learn each task in isolation and discard the procedural knowledge they accumulate. articles.summary: SCAFFOLD is a self-improving framework for visual web agents that induces parametric, executable skills and compresses redundancy recursively. It enables agents to accumulate procedural knowledge across tasks rather than learning each one in isolation.

articles.title: Reasoning-Aware Compression: Identifying and Protecting Vulnerable Reasoning Circuits for Energy-Efficient LLM Deployment
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.05512v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) impose substantial energy costs during deployment, yet current compression methods apply uniform quantization across all components, risking damage to critical reasoning circuits. articles.summary: This paper presents a reasoning-aware compression framework that benchmarks quantization conditions across five reasoning benchmarks with hardware-level energy measurement. articles.title: When and What to Teach: Budget-Aware Online Adaptation for Web Agents
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.05513v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Web agents have achieved significant success in automating complex internet tasks but deploying them in real-world environments requires continuous online adaptation. articles.title: The Failure Happens Before the Drift: The Social Dynamics of Values in LLM Agent Societies

articles.title: Beyond "AI Helps Humans": Decision-Targeted Evaluation Design for Human-Agent Teams in the Agentic Era
articles.snippet: arXiv:2609.05527v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Wherever a coding agent works under engineer supervision, or a clinical model assists a radiologist, the deployment question is whether to keep the human-AI workflow or replace it with the human alone or the agent alone. articles.summary: EdgeMem is an agent-memory method that preserves original interaction turns and organizes them through complementary content, temporal, and episodic cues via a multi-anchor hypergraph. It avoids LLM-generated summaries to reduce cost and retain answer-bearing details.

articles.summary: IntegrityBench, a new benchmark, evaluates LLMs' ability to maintain research integrity under institutional pressure, finding models fail roughly 1 in 3 integrity-critical decisions.

articles.title: Position: The Alignment Community is Unintentionally Building a Censor's Toolkit
articles.snippet: arXiv:2608.12346v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This position paper argues that modern AI alignment methods - originally designed to prevent harmful output - are dual-use technologies that may easily be misused by malicious actors for censorship and manipulation. articles.summary: A position paper warns that modern AI alignment methods designed to prevent harm are dual-use technologies with potential for misuse in censorship and manipulation.

articles.snippet: arXiv:2608.12368v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agreement with human judgments is a common proxy for evaluating the alignment of large language models (LLMs). articles.summary: A study demonstrates that LLM agreement with human ethical judgments masks disagreement on underlying moral grounds, challenging alignment evaluation assumptions.

articles.snippet: arXiv:2608.12373v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used in strategic and advisory contexts, yet their safety alignment is typically evaluated in English only. articles.summary: Dual-Flow Transformers decouple prefill and decode computation paths to optimize hardware utilization for different inference bottlenecks.

articles.summary: Introduces Distribird, an agentic web application that automates the design of informative Bayesian priors by deploying a multi-agent pipeline to extract parameter information from scientific literature.

articles.summary: Proposes CORA-Diff, a training-free acceleration method for diffusion language models that identifies which token positions have stabilized early, skipping unnecessary dense forward passes.

articles.summary: AI code-testing startup Blacksmith's valuation jumped nearly 10x in under a year, with revenue also growing more than tenfold.

bullets.text: OpenAI paused new Pro subscriptions because demand for its Astra model is straining systems, saying it is adding capacity before reopening. It also introduced a Data agent in ChatGPT Work to analyze company data and build dashboards.
bullets.textZhHK: OpenAI因Astra模型需求爆棚而要暫停Pro新訂閱，話要加容量先至重開。佢哋亦喺ChatGPT Work推出Data agent，用自然語言分析公司數據同整儀錶板。

bullets.text: Anthropic published a report alleging persistent distillation attacks by China-based AI companies including Alibaba, Moonshot AI, and DeepSeek, saying they escalated in recent months. It also released its September 2026 misuse detection report and CAPTCHA research.
bullets.textZhHK: Anthropic出報告指控阿里巴巴、Moonshot AI同DeepSeek等中國AI公司持續進行蒸餾攻擊，話近幾個月加劇。佢哋同時發佈咗2026年9月嘅濫用偵測報告同CAPTCHA研究。

bullets.text: Maven Robotics emerged from stealth with a $100 million Series A and active robot deployments, aiming to win robot deployment deals. Meanwhile, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang expects 70% growth next year and insists its deals are not circular.
bullets.textZhHK: Maven Robotics以1億美元A輪融資同已啟動嘅機械人部署正式亮相，想搶機械人部署合約。另一邊廂，Nvidia CEO黃仁勳預期下年增長70%，仲堅稱公司嘅交易唔係循環融資。

bullets.text: Universal Music is launching an AI music platform with ElevenLabs under a multiyear licensing deal, letting users create remixes and mashups from its licensed catalog, with artists able to opt in or out.
bullets.textZhHK: 環球音樂同ElevenLabs簽咗多年授權協議，推出AI音樂平台，用戶可以用授權曲庫整remix同mashup，藝人可以選擇加入或退出。

bullets.text: Meta's AI agent Muse became the No. 2 app in the US, handling shopping, emails and trip-planning, though its start was slower than Meta AI or Threads. Pocket FM said its revenue run rate doubled to $500M with AI powering 93% of content.
bullets.textZhHK: Meta嘅AI助手Muse成為美國第二大app，負責購物、電郵同行程規劃，但起步慢過Meta AI同Threads。Pocket FM話收入運行率倍增至5億美元，93%內容由AI製作。
